Onten OTN-UC501 USB-C to HDMI 2.0 Adapter Cable (4K @ 60Hz)

Project your digital world onto expansive displays with flawless clarity using the Onten OTN-UC501 USB-C to HDMI 2.0 Adapter Cable. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium audio and video hardware accessory is masterfully engineered for modern laptop users, MacBook owners, and smartphone enthusiasts across Egypt who require immediate external display connectivity. It stands as the definitive choice for an instantaneous high-definition screen expansion layout setup without requiring complex external power modification.

The Onten OTN-UC501 features a high-performance USB-C input interface that effortlessly bridges into an HDMI 2.0 layout output channel. Built for demanding media environments, it fully supports cinema-grade 4K Ultra HD resolutions running at a highly fluid 60Hz refresh rate tracking speed, ensuring zero latency, flickering, or image distortion during intense gaming or ultra-high-definition film streaming. Outfitted with a durable shell structure and seamless plug-and-play design, it guarantees top-tier stable daily hardware performance.
